senses.gloss: m. (= h. יְקָר, v. אִי־) honor, glory.—
units: <cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Proverbs 11:16">Targ. Prov. XI, 16</cite>; a. fr.—

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Berakhot 1:1:27">Y. Ber. I, 2ᵈ</cite> <he>איקרִי וכ׳</he> my honor counts for nothing before the honor of my Maker. Ib. II, 4ᵇ <he>מה את פליג ליה א׳</he> (not <he>אתפליג</he>) what honor dost thou pay it (by passing by)?; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Shekalim 2:5:4">Y. Shek. II, 47ᵃ</cite> top.—
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Peah 8:8:13">Y. Peah VIII, 21ᵇ</cite> bot. <he>פרנסה דא׳</he> an honorable livelihood.
Y. Ḥag. I, 76ᵈ top איגרא דא׳, v. אִיגְּרָא.—Pl. אִיקְרִין presents, greetings.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Avodah Zarah 2:8:7">Y. Ab. Zar. II, 41ᵈ</cite> (some ed. <cite ref="A01598"><he>איקלין</he></cite>).
